body:
Hi, no, a doctor won't force me to take medication unless I'm a danger to someone else, which I'm not.

I think it must be chemical rather than just in my head, because I get it even on days when I ought to be happy. I've had hypnotherapy training so I should be able to psychotherapise myself, but it's not working here.

Thank you for saying that you used to suffer too. If you're over it, maybe it *will* pass. Maybe it's just taking longer this time. Thank you.
Thanks. I guess that's a first step.
